response.answer: Your record supports saying that next-morning interviews after market events consistently go well when you have one evening to prepare, whereas same-hour impromptu press hits are documented as a failure format. You can also point to the organization’s established practice of using a scripted, rehearsed answer bank that is reviewed by securities counsel; the overnight slot preserves that preparation and compliance discipline. This is supported by your statements, but the record does not provide specific performance metrics for the same-hour requests.
